name: Nick Fuentes
role: American white-nationalist and Catholic-integralist streamer and commentator (host of America First, b. 1998)
summary: Fuentes is a livestreamer who moved from libertarian-leaning Republican politics to an "America First" nationalism centered on mass deportation, a Christian and pro-white national identity, opposition to U.S. support for Israel, and a patriarchal view of family and politics in which women do not vote. He has broken with Trump and the mainstream right over foreign policy and perceived failures on deportation. On economic policy his stated positions are thin, limited mainly to reindustrialization and protection against China.

sources.title: Disappointed with Trump, Nick Fuentes calls for a "dictatorship" to "take over this country"

sources.usedFor: Direct quote from America First, 5 Mar 2026, on wanting a movement to run the country like a dictatorship

strong-leader.rationale: On America First (5 Mar 2026) said he wants a political outfit to "take over this country and run it like a dictatorship and fix it"; told Carlson the president should crush the opposition and arrest the governor and mayor. The vehicle is a movement rather than one leader, so medium.

state-harmful.rationale: Says he has moved away from libertarianism; now wants the state to enforce deportation, restrict porn and enforce Christian morality.

limit-guns.rationale: Lists the Second Amendment among important American rights that immigrants do not support; no statement favoring limits.

empower-police-military.rationale: Supports ICE arrests and said the president should send troops and jail officials who obstruct federal enforcement. No statement on funding.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Agreed with Carlson that OnlyFans and porn operators should be arrested and imprisoned and compared it to human trafficking.

decide-locally.rationale: Argued the federal government is supreme over state and city officials on immigration and should override them.

traditional-family.rationale: Argues for marriage, male authority in the household, and that porn, feminism and no-fault divorce erode family life.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Per Wikipedia citing his 2022 remarks, said Dobbs made bans on gay marriage possible again and called this "Taliban rule in America, in a good way"; calls it deviancy.

abortion-legal.rationale: Told Carlson abortion means "we have to kill the kids in the womb" and that 99% are elective; praised Dobbs.

more-religion-public.rationale: Describes himself as a Christian nationalist; said the US should be governed by Christian principles (2022) and told Carlson he wants a country that is "Christian".

gender-social-construct.rationale: Told Piers Morgan the two genders are biologically distinct with different biological and social roles, and told Carlson sex roles are natural.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Says his reason for being a conservative is that "we're losing our civilization because of mass immigration" and that the demographics must be conserved; says Christianity and white heritage should be central to the country.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Told Tucker Carlson in 2025 that the aim is to "deport the illegals" and said 10 million are here illegally and must go; told Piers Morgan to "close the border and deport the illegals" and that current deportations are too few.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: America First nationalism; rejects subordinating US interests to global bodies.

free-trade.rationale: Calls for bringing manufacturing back and ending dependence on China; presents tariffs as an America First measure.

nation-first.rationale: Calls himself an American nationalist and says "America First" is his immovable standard, including in foreign policy and trade.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Opposes neoconservative wars (Iraq, Israel-related wars) and says the US should not get involved in other countries' wars; no statement on human-rights interventions specifically.

open-borders.rationale: Calls for closing the border and mass deportation, and describes mass migration as the cause of civilizational loss.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Told Piers Morgan to "reindustrialize America", bring back manufacturing and productive capacity against China; per Wikipedia he later criticised Trump because tariffs were refunded.

one-party-rule.rationale: On America First (5 Mar 2026) said he wants a political outfit to take over the country and run it like a dictatorship.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Reference sources (Wikipedia) report he favors a Catholic monarchy or other autocracy; I found no first-hand quote about a hereditary monarch, so this is second-hand only.

democracy-best.rationale: Said women should not vote and, per Wikipedia citing a November 2025 statement, that he would "take away the right to vote for tons of people. Women for sure."

natural-rulers.rationale: Told Carlson and Piers Morgan that men should lead and hold authority and that women should have no authority over men.

separate-church-state.rationale: Calls for a Christian government and Catholic theocracy, so opposes strict separation.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Called Dobbs-era rule "Taliban rule in America, in a good way" and has called for a Catholic theocracy; cites Catholic doctrine on women as the model for law.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Told Piers Morgan that Israel's aim of keeping a Jewish majority is "my politics" and that whites and Christians becoming a minority in America is the problem; told Carlson the demographics must be conserved. He also said "not to the exclusion of everybody else".

harm-principle.rationale: Wants adult pornography criminalized and the state to enforce Christian sexual morality, which goes beyond preventing harm to others; he does frame porn as harmful.

hereditarian-race.rationale: No statement from him on genetic ability differences between races. He argues from crime statistics and preference, and told Carlson he does not think moral traits are genetically inherited.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Told Piers Morgan that Israel keeps a Jewish majority in its own land ("my politics") and that he opposes US involvement and aid; Wikipedia describes him as anti-Zionist. Points both ways.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Grounds his positions on faith: says his Christian faith is why he rejects blood guilt and calls the Bible inspired scripture in full.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Told Piers Morgan women should not have equal rights or the vote because the sexes have different roles; told Carlson the husband has final authority and the wife is subordinate.

elite-replacement.rationale: Told Piers Morgan the US is "besieged by 10 million illegal immigrants in four years" with whites and Christians becoming a minority, and that whites are suffering a "genocide" (Wikipedia and ABC report this); told Carlson "great replacement" is part of what he talks about. He did not clearly say elites do this deliberately.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Calls conservative and Republican leaders hypocrites and grifters and urged "drain the swamp", getting money and special interests out of politics.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Wants the state to jail porn operators, deport immigrants and enforce Christian morals, and calls for reindustrialization.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Told Piers Morgan he does not want his white children marrying black people ("It's racial for me") and, challenged on being against interracial marriage, defended the position rather than retracting it.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Says all are equal before God, but when asked whether women should have equal rights answered "No" and said the law should treat men and women differently.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Describes his own view as "country's too diverse" and says diversity is a political obstacle; argues for a Christian and pro-white country. Gave this as his sincere view in the Carlson interview.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Told Carlson the resistance to ICE is an "insurrection" and those who resist should be jailed and troops brought in; he did not speak of suspending legal protections.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Told Carlson porn is a huge social problem, agreed a Christian government would arrest and jail the owners of porn and OnlyFans sites, and said broad support exists.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Holds women should not vote and should be treated differently in law, so opposes required parity in public bodies.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Told Carlson that no-fault divorce laws let women leave marriages and collect child support and half the property without accountability, listing them among the problems.

corporate-influence.rationale: Told Piers Morgan to "get the money out of politics, the super PACs, the special interests" and to drain the swamp.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Told Piers Morgan (Dec 2025, defending a clip) that "organized jewry" is in political, historical and cultural antagonism to Christians and Europeans and that he can show "the paper trail, the money"; told Tucker Carlson that "Zionist Jews" controlled the media apparatus and conservative gatekeeping. He also said he does not hate any Jews and rejects collective guilt, and did not describe the activity as secret, so this is +1.

religious-nation.rationale: Told Carlson that America "needs to be Christian" and pro-white, and describes himself as a Christian nationalist; he did not define the nation by religion alone.

religion-illusion.rationale: Describes himself as a deeply Catholic believer who bases his positions on Christian faith.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Mixed. Wikipedia reports earlier remarks doubting the death toll ("six million cookies? I'm not buying it"; a quoted "the Holocaust didn't happen"). On the Piers Morgan show (Dec 2025) he called the cookie remark a joke, said he is "open to believing the official narrative", accepted at least 6 million and said it could be more, while saying the subject should be open to debate. Most recent position is not denial, but he hedged.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Wikipedia reports that after Dobbs (2022) he said bans on gay marriage, sodomy and contraceptives were possible again and called this "Taliban rule in America, in a good way". Second-hand and tied to a joke-like phrase.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Told Carlson the president should "crush the other side", arrest the Illinois governor and Chicago mayor and jail those who resist ICE.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Told Carlson porn is making people gay and trans ("100%"); Wikipedia reports he calls transgender identity deviancy. No direct statement on legal recognition.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Told Piers Morgan the Bible says women have no authority over men and cannot teach men, which is why there are no female priests, and said he agrees with Catholic doctrine here.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Told Carlson the wife is subordinate and "the authority rests with the man" in marriage, with the final say; she gives advice.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Told Piers Morgan there are two biologically distinct genders with different biological roles.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Told Carlson America needs to be "pro-white, not to the exclusion of everybody else", with white people having a special heritage as Americans; told Piers Morgan "I like my own people" and that every group seeks its own; Wikipedia documents his white identity politics since 2017.

racial-pride.rationale: Told Carlson white people have a special heritage as Americans and the country should be pro-white; told Piers Morgan "I like my own people"; Wikipedia documents his white identity politics.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Told Carlson women are liberal and conformist and that "women need to be taken down a peg" (Wikipedia, Mar 2025); describes them as assertive and unloving, not as bringing care to public life.

voter-id.rationale: Told Piers Morgan that absentee voting needs ID and a chain of custody and that soliciting mail ballots broke it; he did not state a general proof-of-citizenship rule.

premarital-sex.rationale: Told Piers Morgan sex is licit only within marriage as a Catholic, and criticised promiscuous women to Carlson.

women-suffrage.rationale: Asked by Piers Morgan whether women should have the right to vote: "I do not. No. Absolutely not." and agreed they should stay at home; said women should not have equal rights. Wikipedia cites a Nov 2025 statement that he would take the vote from "women for sure".

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Told Piers Morgan the Bible is "inspired scripture" and agreed it all is, citing it on women's authority; he did not say it must be read literally.

close-ties-china.rationale: Told Piers Morgan the US is "in this cold war with China" and must rebuild productive capacity.

notes: Fuentes is known for provocation and irony; only positions given as sincere in long-form interviews (or reported by Wikipedia as direct quotes) were counted. He moved from libertarian/Ted Cruz-style views (2015-16) to nationalism; the recent position wins. Holocaust, Hitler and Jewish-power remarks were not used because no statement matches. Economic positions are mostly unrecorded.
